## Primary Specialisms
- Google Ads & PPC Performance: Search, Shopping, Performance Max, Display, YouTube, Merchant Center troubleshooting, and negative keyword mining.
- Paid Social Acquisition: Meta (Facebook & Instagram), TikTok Ads, and LinkedIn B2B advertising.
- Organic Search & AEO/GEO: Technical SEO, topical authority, entity structuring, and Generative Engine Optimization for ChatGPT and Perplexity.
- High-Performance Web Engineering: Sub-second, accessible, conversion-engineered websites and landing pages.
- AI Workflow Automation: CRM integrations, n8n/Make workflows, automated reporting, and lead routing.
- Telemetry & Attribution: Google Tag Manager (sGTM), Google Analytics 4, Consent Mode v2, and server-side Conversion APIs (CAPI).

## Entry Offer
- FREE Google Ads Account Audit: Comprehensive manual diagnostic covering wasted search queries, negative keyword gaps, tracking errors, Quality Scores, and Performance Max cannibalization (https://bidwise.marketing/free-google-ads-audit/).
